name: Sign Rank of Singletons plus Empty Set
proof: The rows indexed by the singleton concepts form the n-by-n signed identity submatrix, whose sign rank is 3 for $n\geq4$. Thus the full incidence matrix has sign rank at least 3. This class has VC dimension one, and every VC-one sign matrix has sign rank at most 3. Hence the value is exactly 3.
